records.text: Owens cited additional Erika Kirk outfits at the December 3 New York Times Book Summit, December 8 Sean Hannity interview, December 9 Fox and Friends and The Five appearances, December 10 Outnumbered appearance, Bari Weiss town hall, December 20 Caleb Chilcutt award, and December 21 Shannon Bream interview.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Sergio Gor's appointment in the Oval Office, that's pretty random. She had clothes then that were fitting. That was on November 10th. The New York Times Book Summit on December 3rd, she had an outfit. I feel like this could have worked also beyond an Alice and Olivia suit. ... The Sean Hannity interview on December 8th, the Fox and Friends on December 9th, co-hosting Fox's The Five, that's on December 9th as well, outnumbered December 10th, Red Jackets, the town hall with Bari Weiss, the black suit, that would have been very appropriate. ... Erica (Erika Kirk), when she gave an award to Caleb Chilcutt, the... on December 20th, that's the day after. So she had clothes by the next day. She had clothes the day after that when she sat down with Erica (Erika Kirk)—with Nicki Minaj. ... And she had clothes on the 21st when I mean, every single one is a different outfit when she released an interview with Shannon Bream.
